metadata.title: Spectral Gap Estimates on Nearly Einstein Manifolds with Integral Curvature Deviation
metadata.abstract: Let $(M^n,g)$ be a compact Riemannian manifold of dimension $n\ge 2$, possibly with nonempty convex $C^2$ boundary. We study the first nonzero eigenvalue $\lambda_1(M)$ of the Laplace--Beltrami operator, subject to the Neumann boundary condition when $\partial M\neq\emptyset$. Given a reference scalar curvature $R_E>0$, set $K_E:=R_E/(n(n-1))$, and define the traceless Ricci tensor $\mathring{\Ric}:=\Ric-\frac{R}{n}g$ and the Einstein deviation \[ \Theta:=|\mathring{\Ric}|+\frac{|R-R_E|}{n},\qquad \kappa_{\mathrm{Ein}}(p):=\left(\frac{1}{\vol(M)}\int_M\Theta^p\,dV\right)^{1/p}, \quad p>n/2. \] We say that $M$ is $\varepsilon$-nearly Einstein if $\kappa_{\mathrm{Ein}}(p)<\varepsilon$. The main result states that for every $\alpha\in(0,1)$ there exists $\varepsilon_0=\varepsilon_0(n,p,\alpha,D,R_E)>0$ such that if $\diam(M)\le D$ and $\kappa_{\mathrm{Ein}}(p)<\varepsilon_0$, then \[ \lambda_1(M)\ge \alpha\,\lambda_1(n,K_E,D), \] where $\lambda_1(n,K,D)$ is the first nonzero eigenvalue of the Bakry--Qian one-dimensional model problem with curvature parameter $K$, with the convention $\lambda_1(n,K,D)=nK$ when $K>0$ and $D\ge\pi/\sqrt{K}$. The proof combines the Bochner formula for the decomposition $\Ric=(n-1)K_Eg+\theta g+\mathring{\Ric}$ with an auxiliary function $J$ satisfying \[ \Delta J-\tau\frac{|\nabla J|^2}{J}-2J\Theta=-\sigma J \] and Neumann boundary conditions, together with Moser iteration and a maximum principle. As $\kappa_{\mathrm{Ein}}(p)\to0$, the estimate recovers the classical Bakry--Qian theorem.

analysis.progressType: 积分 nearly-Einstein 偏差的谱隙
analysis.workSummary: 在紧 n≥2 流形、直径上界及 Lᵖ Einstein 偏差小的条件下，以任意 α<1 获第一非零特征值的 Bakry–Qian 模型下界；凸 C² 边界使用 Neumann 条件。
analysis.breakthrough: 由积分而非逐点曲率控制稳定恢复经典谱隙比较。
analysis.limitations: p>n/2，偏差小阈值依赖维数、直径、参考曲率及 α。
